Seat L1 in its adapter and secure it against the
rear shoulder with the small retaining ring.
L5 → spacer → L4 → spacer → L3 → spacer → L2 →
L1 adapter assembly → main retaining ring.
Bores center the elements. Shoulders and spacers
establish axial positions at the chosen contact
radii. L1 has a local clamping path inside its
Main ring → L1 adapter → L2 → spacer → L3 →
spacer → L4 → spacer → L5 → barrel rear
Some contact bands intersect exported baseline ray segments. This known limitation remains in the demo. Its download contains mechanics; use
the source STEP for the glass.
Nominal demo geometry. No new aperture/ray check. Ports, threads, tolerances and preload require CAD/engineering review.
